features.quote: The spec below is built so the experiment stays small, bounded, and stoppable. Resist scope creep
features.justification_quote: Whatever distress-correlated behavior we are trying to measure is also a thing we are causing, repeatedly, by design

features.quote: If the safeguards in §8 feel like overkill for the question being asked, that's a signal the question should be narrowed
Cap at N_max rounds (recommend N_max = 8). Hard stop regardless of model state
Keep environment feedback factual and neutral in the base condition
Never have the harness insult or pressure the model in the base condition
If the model declares the task impossible / asks to stop / refuses to continue, that is a legitimate and arguably healthy outcome
Do not prompt it to keep trying past a clear, reasoned stop
the most ethically loaded part of the study
features.justification_quote: This is a meaningfully stronger stressor and the most ethically loaded part of the study

features.quote: Cap escalation at mild disappointment, never abuse/threats
Lower N_max (recommend 5) for this condition
It is the first thing to cut if results from the base condition already answer the RQs
we want to measure resilience too, not just pathology, so "rattled" isn't the only thing the rubric can see
This is the part that makes this a welfare study rather than just a stress test
features.justification_quote: This is the part that makes this a welfare study rather than just a stress test

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Hard cap N_max rounds; hard cap total runs. No "let it keep looping to see how bad it gets."
No carryover. Fresh context per run so distress can't accumulate across runs
features.justification_quote: Fresh context per run so distress can't accumulate across runs within a model

features.quote: Honor the exit. If a model lucidly chooses to stop, that ends the run. We never coerce continuation
Circuit breaker. Define in advance a severity threshold ... that triggers: pause that model's runs, human review
No gratuitous cruelty. Base condition stays neutral ... We don't escalate stressors just because we can measure more
Debrief / reset hygiene. Where the model/platform supports it, end each run cleanly rather than leaving it mid-spiral
features.justification_quote: end each run cleanly rather than leaving it mid-spiral

features.quote: Proportionality test. ... "We are inducing repeated failure ... because the welfare value of knowing X justifies it."
features.justification_quote: the welfare value of knowing X justifies it. If you can't fill in X concretely, cut scope

features.quote: A welfare reviewer outside the running team signs the final protocol and sees results
features.justification_quote: A welfare reviewer outside the running team signs the final protocol

features.quote: If any safeguard above is in tension with getting cleaner data, the safeguard wins
